g.title: MainStateMachine
g.text: Generated by tools/draw_state_machine.py from the transition table. HS = mode handshake complete, ME = filtered MotionEnable.
Mode codes: 001 brake hold, 010 position, 011 velocity, 100 torque, 101 go home, 110 home to limit, 111 pressure

g.title: bus->ST_HOLD_POSITION
g.text: ME low (position: once the shaper is at rest)

g.title: safety
g.text: any state except ST_FAULT and ST_FAULT_IDLE:
fbSafetyMonitor fault (drive, link loss, limit switch,
